deadline.value: The Civil & Environmental Engineering Ph.D. pages do not state an application deadline.

gre_subject.value: ETS does not offer a GRE Subject Test in Civil Engineering.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The Civil & Environmental Engineering Ph.D. pages do not state whether pre-admission faculty contact or supervisor agreement is required.

funding.value: Teaching and research fellowships providing tuition and a monthly stipend are available to Ph.D. students on a highly competitive basis.
funding.quote: The Rowan Civil & Environmental Engineering Department offers financial aid to its graduate students in the form of teaching and research fellowships. These fellowships are available to Ph.D. students or Master's students in the thesis/research track and are highly competitive.

also.quote: Research fellowships require a student to work with an adviser on a project funded by a grant. The fellowship provides tuition and a stipend. | Teaching fellowships require a student to teach 3 credits per semester. The fellow receives tuition and a monthly stipend.

entry_route.value: Applicants may enter directly with a bachelor's degree (72 graduate credits required) or with a related master's degree (42 graduate credits required).
entry_route.quote: Students require a minimum of 72 credits of graduate level work beyond a bachelor degree. | If you possess a Master's degree in a related field, a minimum of 42 semester hours of graduate level work beyond your Master's degree will be required.

notes: Department houses Environmental Engineering research concentrations alongside Civil Engineering (Rowan has no standalone Environmental Science Ph.D.).
